    FAILED = "failed"

    def __post_init__(self):

    def cancel(self) -> bool:
        """Cancel the task. Returns True if cancelled, False if already completed or running."""

        self.cancelled_event.set()
        if self.future and not self.future.done():
            self.future.cancel()
        return True

    def is_cancelled(self) -> bool:
        return self.cancelled_event.is_set() or self.state == TaskState.CANCELLED
